alex: quick Q — noticed a discrepancy between Python SDK and TS/REST on how optional params are serialized. Python sends explicit null for `top_k` if None, TS omits the field. Server treats null as an override -> top_k=0 which breaks reranks. anyone seen this? :thinking:

priya: yeah saw this in #support yesterday. python's `json.dumps` includes None -> null unless we filter. server currently treats null as an explicit set.

matt: repro payloads: python ->
```json
{"model": "rwd-small", "top_k": null, "max_tokens": 128}
```
ts ->
```json
{"model": "rwd-small", "maxTokens": 128}
```

jen: ouch. backward compatibility should be: null == omitted. we can't have old clients accidentally changing behavior.

alex: agree. what's the lowest-risk fix? server ignoring nulls or SDK omitting nulls?

priya: short-term server-side is safest: accept both `top_k` and `topK` and treat null as missing. add a warning log to detect callers relying on explicit null.

matt: server change needs API review though. sdk change (python) is very small: filter None before encoding. we should do both: quick sdk patch + tolerant server.

jen: note: openapi defines snake_case on the wire. TS client maps to camelCase and serializes to snake_case; the naming mapping isn't the bug here — it's explicit nulls from python.

alex: propose plan:
1) patch python SDK to omit None fields (patch release)
2) server tolerant fix in next minor to ignore nulls & log
3) add regression test that asserts omitted vs null behave the same

priya: SGTM. PR for python: https://git.company/pr/2345 (adds filter to payload builder).

ci-bot: deploy-bot: linked PR merged to `fix/sdk/null-omit` — CI passing. https://git.company/pr/2345 :rocket:

matt: i'll open the server PR to treat null as missing and add a compatibility test. tagging @security for visibility — any concerns? @security

jen: no security concerns from my side. just include in changelog and add a short migration note for any clients that might rely on explicit null semantics (unlikely but be safe).

alex: thanks all — i'll update the SDK changelog and add the regression test. will also ping if we need a patch release cut. :thumbsup:
